headline: Bangladesh outraged over India allowing Hasina's media interaction in New Delhi
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs calls the event 'detrimental' to bilateral ties and asserts that Sheikh Hasina has no place in the country's politics.
details: Bangladesh has expressed deep anger after India allowed former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to interact with the media in New Delhi. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that Hasina and her associates used the platform to make 'poisonous' remarks against the state and its people.

// The Ministry noted that India was previously informed about the potential negative impact such an event could have on the process of rebuilding bilateral relations, yet the permission was still granted.
The government described Hasina's media appearance as an insult to Bangladesh's sovereignty and a sign of extreme disrespect toward the martyrs of the July Revolution.
The Ministry further asserted that the 'fascist' regime's attempts to deny the killings of civilians and children during July-August 2024 are failed attempts to rewrite history.
Bangladesh has repeatedly requested the extradition of Sheikh Hasina under the 2013 extradition treaty, but the Ministry stated that India has yet to respond to these requests.
The statement concluded that allowing Hasina to speak publicly under any pretext is harmful to the development of friendly bilateral relations and deeply hurts the feelings of the Bangladeshi people.

headline_marked: Petrol bomb and cocktails [[hurled at Shakib Al Hasan's house]] in Magura
headline: Petrol bomb and cocktails hurled at Shakib Al Hasan's house in Magura
summary: Attackers targeted the gate of the former national cricket captain and former MP's residence on Wednesday night.
details: Miscreants hurled petrol bombs and cocktails at the gate of Shakib Al Hasan's house in Magura on Wednesday night.
The attack took place at the Keshab Mor intersection, targeting the upper part of the iron gate on the south side of the residence.
Police reported that the fire started by the explosives was extinguished shortly after the incident.
A team from the Magura Sadar Police Station arrived at the scene following the report and has since deployed police personnel for security.
Authorities have not yet identified the perpetrators of the attack.
Police are currently investigating the cause of the incident and the nature of the explosives used.
